claim: Despite passing the Senate on June 9, 2025, S4641 died in the Assembly Labor Committee before the legislative session ended
excerpt:
I n recent years, several states have enacted statutes banning or significantly limiting an employer’s ability to require an employee to enter into a covenant not to compete. On Feb. 10, 2025, Sen. Sean Ryan introduced a bill (S4641) that, if enacted, would put New York in that category.

Having passed the Senate on June 9, 2025, the bill was delivered to the Assembly Labor Committee for consideration.
